items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR
Contract WW-741R, Various Locations Spot Main Sewer Replacement No. 1 to replace/line existing sewers on specified streets in San Francisco
items.text: Award Contract WW-741R, Various Locations Spot Main Sewer Replacement No. 1, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, K.J. Woods Construction, Inc., in the amount of $6,188,000 and with a duration of 410 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and two months), to replace/line existing sewers on specified streets in the City and County of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action

items.title: Contract No. WD-2900, Millbrae Campus Improvements, to Clark Construction Group as Construction Manager/General Contractor to construct the Millbrae Campus Improvements Project
items.text: Award Contract No. WD-2900, Millbrae Campus Improvements, to Clark Construction Group – California, LP, as Construction Manager/General Contractor, for a total contract amount not to exceed $268,932,944 and with a duration of 2,343 consecutive calendar days (approximately six years and six months); and authorize proceeding only with pre- construction services during the design phase in the not-to-exceed amount of $5,114,166 with a duration of 1,380 consecutive calendar days (approximately three years and ten months), within the total contract amount and duration, to construct the Millbrae Campus Improvements Project including: renovate existing buildings into industrial shop and storage buildings; construct a new two-story combined laboratory and office building; and retrofit the Administration Building

items.title: Approve Contract No. WD-2878A, Regional Groundwater Storage and Recovery Phase 2A, with Marinship Development Interest LLC
items.text: Approve an increase of 300 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WD-2878A, Regional Groundwater Storage and Recovery Phase 2A, with Marinship Development Interest LLC, for a revised duration limit of up to 1,258 consecutive calendar days (approximately three years and six months), with no change to contract amount, to provide additional time to properly install vertical turbine lineshafts with the approved operation and maintenance manual

items.title: Contract No. WW-719A, Folsom Area Stormwater Improvements - SOMA and Mission Districts Sewer Replacement, with Mitchell Engineering due to a safety work stoppage, cost overruns and due to an unforeseen conflict
items.text: Approve an increase of $350,000 to the cost contingency and an increase of 140 calendar days to the duration contingency for Contract No. WW-719A, Folsom Area Stormwater Improvements – SOMA and Mission Districts Sewer Replacement, with Mitchell Engineering, for a revised cost limit of up to $8,624,245 and a revised duration limit to 697 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and ten months), due to a safety work stoppage and investigation after the Contractor damaged the MUNI overhead catenary wires on 11th Street, multiple demobilizations and remobilizations to accommodate Special Event street fair closures on 11th Street, cost overruns on a brick sewer repair, and due to an unforeseen conflict with an unidentified drainage pipe, with no change to the locations or alignments of work
